name: Craft Omakase

menus.name: 22 Course Omakase Experience
menus.note: The only menu; prepaid on Tock with a 20% service charge and tax ($222 a person before tax); 12 seats at a communal sushi counter

bookingOpens: Online on Tock, paid in full when booking. A new week of tables is released every Sunday at noon Austin time, keeping about 35 days open.

bookingWindow.note: A new week is released each Sunday at noon, keeping 35 days open.

cancellation: The $185 price, 20% service charge and tax are not refunded. Bookings can be moved by emailing info@craftomakase.com, but not within 48 hours of the reservation. A booking can be transferred to someone else.
walkIns: No walk-ins: only guests with a paid omakase seat can dine. Parties arriving more than 30 minutes late cannot be seated.
groups: Up to six guests per booking at the communal counter. Larger groups can book all 12 seats as a private seating through the request form on Tock.
children: Children are welcome only with their own paid seat for the full omakase; no high chairs, carriers or babies on laps.
byob: Corkage is $60 a bottle for wine or sake.
